seasonRead.headline: 2024–25: A modern forward corps is a portfolio, not a prototype
paragraphs: Perimeter Skill Scorer leads, but three other profiles occupy substantial parts of the lineup. The clearest contrast is between scoring from space and the territorial contribution captured by Two-Way Shot-Share Driver.

Checking-Line Disruptor and Shot-Blocking Contact Specialist describe separate support lanes, although their names are stronger than the direct contact evidence underneath them. The useful hockey insight is role coverage: creation, disruption, defensive detail and shot-share work all need roster space.

seasonRead.headline: 2024–25: Puck movement comes in several risk settings
paragraphs: Defensive Role Defenseman leads a blue-line spectrum that runs from shot-and-chance exposure to raw production and active rush involvement. The broad label is a starting point, not a complete description of the defenders inside it.

Offensive Puck-Moving Defenseman carries the clearer scoring signature, while Low-Event Puck-Moving Defenseman is quieter and lower-contact rather than a proven transition driver. Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman is the more assertive play-driving option, whether through extending possessions or adding dangerous offense. Roster construction is about choosing the right setting for each pair.
